prompt: This flat vector illustration depicts a bustling farm harvest scene. On the far left stands a tall man in a blue flannel shirt holding a pitchfork upright. Next to him is a small brown dog sitting calmly on the grass. A woman in a yellow sunhat points toward the center of the field where a large red tractor is parked. The tractor has black wheels and a visible exhaust pipe. Sitting on the tractor seat is a boy in green overalls looking at the woman. To the right of the tractor, an older man in a grey cap hands a woven basket to a girl in a pink dress. The girl reaches out with both hands to accept the basket. Behind them, a white barn with a red roof anchors the background. Leaning against the barn wall is a wooden ladder. A black cat sleeps on the bottom rung of the ladder. In the center foreground, a pile of orange pumpkins rests on the ground. A scarecrow with a straw hat stands next to the pumpkin pile. A crow perches on the scarecrow's shoulder. On the right side, a woman in purple boots kneels beside a row of corn stalks. She picks an ear of corn with her right hand. A brown horse stands behind her, tethered to a fence post. The horse looks toward the left side of the image. Near the horse, a metal bucket sits on the ground. A chicken pecks at the ground next to the bucket. Above the barn, a bright yellow sun shines in a clear blue sky. There is no rain in the sky. There is no modern machinery like a combine harvester. There is no text or signage on the barn.
